defaultsHint: New distributions start from these values. You can still change them each time, and sets you already gave out stay as they are.
percentHint: 100% is one round of the chosen cards, 200% is two. Off means optional study.
speechHint: Students can change it on the study screen.
afterDueHint: Used only when a distribution has a due date.
allClassesHint: Other classes keep their own lesson notes and order.
applyExistingHint: This changes the settings of {n} active {type} in this class. Each one keeps its card range and study records. Tests in progress are graded with the settings they started with.
applyFailed: {n} could not be changed. Please try again.
filled: Filled in from your class study defaults. You can change them for this distribution only.
planHint: Put notes between rows and set the order. Students see the same order and notes. Hidden rows are not shown to students, but their records stay.
emptyMemo: A note is empty. Write something or remove it.
unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
noRows: No sets given to this class yet. You can add notes first.
